Check package ownership, dependency resolution, Metro, autolinking, app boundaries, navigation, API/auth, persistence, security, and Expo or bare React Native integration. Use when designing or reviewing React Native architecture.

skills.name: olko-react-native-security
skills.description: Review React Native mobile apps for security issues across JavaScript, native Android/iOS configuration, storage, authentication, networking, deep links, WebViews, logs, dependencies, and release builds. Use for focused security reviews or when changing sensitive mobile flows; follow project rules and report evidence with severity.

skills.name: olko-react-native-style

Read project rules, run configured ESLint/Prettier/type checks, and inspect hooks, components, platform boundaries, accessibility, and mobile performance patterns. Use when reviewing or formatting React Native changes.

skills.name: olko-react-native-testing

Apply configured Jest/React Native Testing Library and E2E conventions, check meaningful assertions and platform coverage, and report failures without hiding unavailable infrastructure. Use when validating React Native tests or adding mobile feature coverage.
